caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a rectangular chest or cabinet with three distinct sections. The entire piece is colored in a uniform reddish-brown wood tone, suggesting it is made or finished with a similar material throughout. The top compartment, which spans the full width of the cabinet, appears to be a drop-front or fall-front section with a keyhole at the center. Below this section are two separate drawers, each with a small round pull handle on either side and a central keyhole. The cabinet stands on four short, outwardly angled legs, each with a slightly tapered shape. The background is plain and off-white, emphasizing the object with no other visible elements or decorations.
title: Shaker Chest of Drawers
